description: This file defines a React (Preact) functional component named 'Pagination' used for rendering pagination controls in a search results UI. It calculates the number of pages, determines which pages to display, and manages navigation buttons for previous, next, and specific page selection.

methods.name: Pagination({ counter, start, settings, onPageSelect })
methods.description: React functional component that renders pagination controls based on total item count ('counter'), current start index ('start'), settings object ('settings'), and callback ('onPageSelect') for page navigation.
